goal: Create the React/Vite/TypeScript project, set up global design tokens, and render the static desktop shell.
summary: Phase 1 completed: scaffolded a React + TypeScript + Vite project with Tailwind CSS v4, created a centralized Tahoe theme system (tokens, ThemeProvider, CSS variables), and built the static desktop shell (Wallpaper, MenuBar, Desktop container, ContextMenu).
